📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
This is occurrence #107 (last_notified_at was 2026-08-02T17:12:00Z — ~2d9h20m ago, 24h suppression window had expired).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (runtime-core-subscriber-api) / `Admin` (mobile-notifications-stack) — split by service, DD monitor tags say `team:crm` for both
Playbook: Confirm shape (monitor is one of the 5 sibling team:crm AMQP-consumer IDs, name matches "throughput dropped" or "heartbeat — consumer silent") → pull `dd_search.py metric` for the fired service's AMQP hits rate → expect a near-threshold dip that self-recovers within minutes, 0 corroborating errors.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_status monitoring-noise-suspected-unconfirmed

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded cycle, no Slack MCP this session (proxy: DD monitor 302057011, fired 2026-08-05T02:44:31Z)

Root-cause analysis:
  • Query: DD metric `sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:runtime-core-subscriber,env:prod}.as_rate()`, window 02:24:31–03:04:31Z
  • Observed: sparse/bursty series, mostly 0.1–5 msg/s with occasional bursts to 20–127 msg/s — the monitor's `avg(last_15m) < 2` threshold trips during natural quiet-period dips in this pattern
  • Reasoning: same shape as 106 prior occurrences; 0 ES error hits for runtime-core-subscriber over the fire window confirms no application failure — quiet-period flap, not a stall

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302057011
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command.hits&exp_scope=env%3Aprod%2Cservice%3Aruntime-core-subscriber&exp_agg=sum&start=1785896671&end=1785899071
  • Kibana: 0 hits in window (fields.dd_service.keyword:"runtime-core-subscriber", Level.keyword aggregate) — confirms no error signature
  • This-window concentration: n/a — metric-only KB, no log signal to concentrate

Note: a second sibling fire (monitor 302055141, notifications-subscriber heartbeat, 08:33:22Z) hit this same KB entry later in this cycle and was suppressed — same-cycle gate-ordering artifact (this post's last_notified_at bump landed first). Logged in docs/actionable/2026-08-05.md for visibility.

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-05-rainforest-outbound-api-p95-latency`
This is occurrence #18 (last_notified_at was 2026-08-03T18:28:25Z — ~1d11h47m ago, 24h suppression window had expired).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Transactions` (Payment processing component, per ownership.md:119 — monitor tag `team:transactions` agrees)
Playbook: Confirm shape (monitor 295928665, p95 on peer.hostname:api.rainforestpay.com) → widen the query window (data is sparse) → expect a real but brief third-party latency elevation, 0 corroborating errors on runtime-core-api. Root cause is third-party (Rainforest infra) — no Method-side fix; escalate to Ben only if errors start appearing or frequency increases sharply.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_status monitoring-noise-suspected-unconfirmed

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded cycle, no Slack MCP this session (proxy: DD monitor 295928665, fired 2026-08-05T06:15:26Z)

Root-cause analysis:
  • Query: DD metric `p95:trace.http.request{env:prod,peer.hostname:api.rainforestpay.com}`, window 06:05:26–06:15:26Z
  • Observed: 39 sparse datapoints, 0.27–2.27s, all under the 3s threshold (monitor's own 10m rollup evidently caught a brief sub-bucket peak not visible at this resolution)
  • Latency-only confirmation: `service:runtime-core-api status:error env:prod`, same window → 0 hits
  • Reasoning: same sparse/near-threshold non-reproduction shape as ~10 of the 17 prior occurrences — genuine but brief third-party latency, not a Method defect

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/295928665
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.http.request&exp_scope=env%3Aprod%2Cpeer.hostname%3Aapi.rainforestpay.com&exp_agg=p95&start=1785909926&end=1785911726
  • Kibana: n/a — not the evidence datasource for this KB (evidence_source: datadog_apm)
  • This-window concentration: n/a — third-party outbound latency, no ES log signal

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-ms-account-api-4xx-spike-monitor-noise`
This is occurrence #48 (last_notified_at was 2026-08-01T19:34:18Z — ~3d12h14m ago, 24h suppression window had expired).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin`
Playbook: Confirm shape (monitor 299551518 transitions state without a genuine >300/15min 4xx count) → run the evidence_query directly against the 4xx-hits metric → single-digit/empty result confirms the known noise pattern → check service:ms-account-api status:error for corroboration (expect 0).
Open Jira: n/a — fix_status monitoring-noise-suspected-unconfirmed

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded cycle, no Slack MCP this session (proxy: DD monitor 299551518, fired 2026-08-05T07:48:19Z)

Root-cause analysis:
  • Query: DD metric `sum:trace.aspnet_core.request.hits.by_http_status{service:ms-account-api,env:prod,http.status_class:4xx}.as_count()`, monitor's own 15m eval window
  • Observed: only 4 sparse datapoints of value 1 visible at query resolution — far under the 300 threshold (rollup-artifact under-sampling of the monitor's own finer aggregation)
  • Corroboration: `service:ms-account-api status:error` and `@http.status_code:[400 TO 499]` in DD Logs, same window → 0 hits both; ES level:Error aggregate → 0 hits
  • Reasoning: same rollup-artifact non-reproduction shape as 47 prior occurrences — monitor-sensitivity/config artifact, not a real 4xx breach

Evidence:

  • Kibana: 0 hits in window (fields.dd_service.keyword:"ms-account-api" AND level.keyword:Error) — confirms no error signature
  • This-window concentration: n/a — 0 hits, nothing to concentrate

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
This is occurrence #629 (last_notified_at was 2026-08-04T15:05:11Z — ~24h39m ago, 24h suppression window had expired).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin`
Playbook: 1) Confirm chronic baseline by comparing ES Ocelot.Responder.Middleware Warning volume in the alert window vs the same window 24h ago — if delta < 20%, it's the chronic pattern (no new incident). 2) Aggregate timeouts by RequestPath: if dominant paths are all under upstream microservices.methodlocal.int, it's pool-level. 3) Check ki-dns-microservices-method-int-pps-quota first — DNS bursts on the Windows fleet present here as Ocelot timeouts. 4) If DNS is clean: identify which downstream microservice owns the slow path via Ocelot config in ms-gateway-api/gateway/API/ocelot.*.json. 5) Decision tree for the fix: (a) raise per-route Ocelot timeout, (b) scale microservices IIS pool / shorten recycle interval, (c) profile the upstream microservice under prod load.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_status chronic-residual-post-rollback-2026-06-05

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded cycle, no Slack MCP this session (proxy: DD monitor 77419271, fired 2026-08-05T15:44:11Z)

Root-cause analysis:
  • Query: DD Logs `service:method-ui -*ResizeObserver* -*segment* -*signalr* -*mixpanel* -*hotjar* -"Minified Redux error" status:error *xhr*`, window 15:39:11–15:44:11Z (monitor's own trailing-5m eval window)
  • Observed: 10 XHR failures, http.status_code:0 ("Failed to load"), across 8 diffuse accounts and 8 diffuse ISP/geography combinations, mostly hitting /gateway/syncutil/syncwidget/<account>/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync
  • Reasoning: diffuse-account + diffuse-geography + client-side-failure (status_code 0, not server 5xx) matches this entry's established client-network/shared-gateway-tier signature, not an account-specific or server-side error

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/77419271
  • DD logs: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Amethod-ui%20-%2AResizeObserver%2A%20-%2Asegment%2A%20-%2Asignalr%2A%20-%2Amixpanel%2A%20-%2Ahotjar%2A%20-%22Minified%20Redux%20error%22%20status%3Aerror%20%2Axhr%2A&from_ts=1785944351000&to_ts=1785944651000&live=false
  • Kibana: 0 hits in window (not the evidence datasource for this KB — corroborated via DD Logs instead)
  • This-window concentration: 8 accounts, 1 hit each — diffuse, no single-account concentration

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-06-synthetics-signin-transient-step-duration-spike`
This is occurrence #36 (last_notified_at was 2026-08-03T20:03:09Z — ~45h ago, 24h suppression window had expired).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin`
Playbook: 1) Confirm shape: monitor 127198928 in Alert (or recently Alert, now OK) with last_triggered_ts within the last ~15 min; check the underlying avg:synthetics.browser.step.duration metric for the actual peak value and how many points exceeded 20s (expect exactly 1 point historically). 2) Check for co-firing critical-path monitors (gateway, oauth2, ms-authentication-api, ms-identity-api, signin) in the same +/-15min window; if any are also in Alert, treat as a shared-upstream-slowness incident, not this noise pattern. 3) Run ES aggregate for level:Error across oauth2.identity.server / gateway / ms-authentication-api / ms-identity-api in a tight window around the spike; if genuinely 0, and DD RUM/Error-Tracking on method-signin-ui is also 0, this is the established noise pattern. 4) If error signal ever appears, treat as a NEW finding, don't fold into this entry. 5) If this recurs with the same no-evidence shape, consider recommending Admin raise the monitor's threshold or require 2 consecutive breaches before firing.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_status needs-human

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded cycle, no Slack MCP this session (proxy: DD monitor 127198928, fired 2026-08-05T17:02:08Z)

Root-cause analysis:
  • Query: DD metric `avg:synthetics.browser.step.duration{step_id IN (447-as9-ktg,x93-d6z-ir9,3w5-4fp-rsq,rrq-u73-wwr)}`, window 16:40:00–17:10:00Z
  • Observed: single-point breach 20002ms @17:00:00Z (0.01% over the 20000ms threshold — smallest margin on record in this entry's 36-occurrence history), recovered to 6298ms by 17:10:00Z
  • Corroboration: ES level:Error across oauth2.identity.server/ms-gateway-api/ms-authentication-api/ms-identity-api, 16:55:00-17:07:00Z → 12 hits, all sampled and ruled unrelated (recurring MongoDB DuplicateKey OAuth-grant noise + a single malformed-token /jwt/validate failure from an anonymous, all-null-context request 4m before the spike); DD RUM errortracking service:method-signin-ui → 0 client errors
  • Reasoning: threshold-grazing single-run spike with immediate self-recovery and no corroborating sign-in-flow error — matches this entry's established synthetic-probe-jitter signature

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/127198928
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=synthetics.browser.step.duration&exp_scope=step_id%3A447-as9-ktg&exp_agg=avg&start=1785947528&end=1785949928
  • Kibana: n/a — not the evidence datasource for this KB (evidence_source: datadog_apm)
  • This-window concentration: n/a — no log signal attributable to the sign-in flow
